name: nerdio-mcp
description: The first non-PowerShell client for the Nerdio Manager for MSP API - cross-account AVD fleet audits, async-job plumbing, and offline search no other Nerdio tool has.

nerdio_base_url.title: NERDIO_BASE_URL
nerdio_base_url.description: Your NMM instance root URL (per-MSP install), e.g. https://nmm.contoso.com. Required - there is no vendor-global endpoint.

nerdio_token_url.title: NERDIO_TOKEN_URL
nerdio_token_url.description: Entra ID token endpoint for your tenant: https://login.microsoftonline.com/<TENANT_ID>/oauth2/v2.0/token

nerdio_client_id.title: NERDIO_CLIENT_ID
nerdio_client_id.description: Sets NERDIO_CLIENT_ID for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

nerdio_client_secret.title: NERDIO_CLIENT_SECRET
nerdio_client_secret.description: Sets NERDIO_CLIENT_SECRET for the Nerdio Manager MCP server.

nerdio_oauth_scope.title: NERDIO_OAUTH_SCOPE
nerdio_oauth_scope.description: Sets NERDIO_OAUTH_SCOPE for the Nerdio Manager MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.

nerdio_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
nerdio_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

nerdio_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
nerdio_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

nerdio_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
nerdio_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

nerdio_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
nerdio_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

nerdio_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
nerdio_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Nerdio Manager requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
